correctness.rationale: For H_n=n(2n-1), n>=2, gcd of consecutive generators is controlled by 3 and the long pair by gcd(n,2)gcd(n,3)gcd(2n-1,5)<=30, ensuring gcd of all is one. The triple is minimal except n=3 where H_5=3H_3 and the remaining coprime pair gives a symmetric numerical semigroup. For n>=61 the four explicit positive quadratic differences exclude representations of the remaining generator in each pair/its gcd; for the (a,c) pair, any candidate forces x+y=d and x=d/2+d/(4n+3), nonintegral for d<=30. Hence published minimal-three-generator symmetry criterion excludes all n>=61 without experimental extrapolation. For 2<=n<=60, the three possible pair-gcd representations are decided by finite exhaustive integer loops; separately implemented exact Apéry shortest paths yield 2g=F+1 only for n=2,3,6,7,8,18, agreeing with the source five explicit witnesses and the n=3 exception. Thus the exact all-index classification is correct within the established semigroup criterion.
